warnings: STRUCTURAL roof framing plan (steel hip/ridge/rafter members with marks and grid refs) — recorded as pattern 'plan' per the roof_plan-vs-plan rule, not as pattern 'roof_plan' (which is architectural-only).

Two distinct bracket/leader symbols are used for the built-up members: an open-channel symbol (⊏, used for จันทัน and the two heavier ตะเข้สัน/อกไก่ callouts at 100x50x5x7.5mm) and a different closed/box-looking symbol (⊡, used for the lighter ตะเข้ราง/ตะเข้สัน/อกไก่ callouts at 100x50x20x3.2mm). Both are recorded with designation 'C' (lipped/rolled channel family per schema §6a) since the printed dimension pattern (100x50x[lip-or-web]x[thickness]) matches the schema's own 'C' worked example in both cases — genuine uncertainty remains over whether the ⊡ symbol denotes a different back-to-back/box orientation of the same channel product rather than a distinct profile family. Flagged rather than guessed; a vector-level read of the source PDF would resolve this.

Diagonal hip/ridge/valley members do not run along the plan grid the same way beams do (they run corner-to-ridge at 45°) — grid_ref is recorded as an approximate location description rather than grid_ref_start/grid_ref_end, consistent with the stair convention (§10a) for non-orthogonal members.

Two different sizes are printed for both 'ตะเข้สัน' (hip) and 'อกไก่' (ridge): a heavier pair (2x C100x50x5x7.5mm, 9.36 kg/m) at the main hip/ridge, and a lighter pair (2x C100x50x20x3.2mm, 5.50 kg/m) together with a valley member 'ตะเข้ราง' (also 2x C100x50x20x3.2mm) at what is inferred to be a secondary, lower roof over the S0 carport/porch south of grid A — inferred from the roof plan's non-rectangular outline and the carport slab position on the floor plans, not from an explicit label distinguishing 'main roof' vs 'porch roof' on this sheet.

A small 1:20 detail on the same sheet ('ขยาย 1') shows the rafter-tail-to-column connection: จันทันเหล็ก (rafter) welded to a 50x300x6.00mm steel tail plate (เหล็กหางปลา) cast into the concrete column top — recorded as a separate installation_detail element.

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'roof_frame_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 7 roof-framing elements. Nothing else in this file changed.
